timezone_rule: Use the source fact's preserved offset; use timezone_name only when offset is absent. DAILY source facts retain their existing local_date.
missing_rule: Missing groups produce no feature row. Explicit empty vendor segment lists may produce segment_count=0 with episode context.
quality_gating: Exclude only facts FLAGGED for structural validity or provenance completeness; UNKNOWN vendor semantic certainty is retained and labelled.
source_resolution_rule: Never aggregate different source_sid/source_class groups together. UNRESOLVED source decisions remain source-scoped.
